recognition.summary: Central public acknowledgment is reserved for validated security vulnerabilities with demonstrable impact.

reporting.summary: Honeywell publishes direct PSIRT and other security-reporting email channels.

rewards.summary: Honeywell explicitly offers neither a bug bounty nor monetary incentives.

limitations: Count the group once. Internally known or otherwise excluded reports may not qualify; unauthorized production scanning is expressly not authorized.
